# shadcn stylesheet

`tailwind.css` is the unchanged stylesheet from the MIT-licensed `shadcn` npm package, version 4.14.0 (`dist/tailwind.css`). `LICENSE.md` is copied from that same package. Source: https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/tree/main/packages/shadcn

SHA-256: `bc7d83425702955b4cb67cb14ede9d603f9d912376d57a2d81d661094d2a782a`.

MyEve imports only this asset. Keeping the licensed asset locally removes the unused generator/MCP CLI and its unpatched `braces` dependency without changing CSS output. Updating this asset requires preserving its license and intentionally updating the security regression's digest.
